description: Return changes (VAT status, bank accounts, or registry data — name, address, KRS, REGON — from the White List) detected since a given date for the NIPs you monitor. The field property is one of: status_vat, account_added, account_removed, name, address, krs, regon. A polling channel for agents. Requires a skanfirmy API key.

api_key.description: skanfirmy API key (optional, if not in the header).

since.description: ISO date/timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-01). Returns changes since that date. Defaults to the beginning.

name: changes_since
